issues.description: The `set_bit` helper redundantly stacks bare `#[verus_verify]` on top of `#[verus_verify(dual_spec)]`.
issues.rationale: `#[verus_verify(dual_spec)]` already selects verification and provides the dual executable/spec definition for the spec-compatible helper body, so a separate bare `#[verus_verify]` directly above it adds no mode or contract information. Same-commit guideline `pair-exec-helpers-with-spec-models` says to use the lightest mechanism and specifically chooses `#[verus_verify(dual_spec)]` when one body serves both modes. Reviewer rikosellic identifies the redundancy, the author agrees, and final commit 5ed7a2c167d0faaf215beb1b5844fefe125e2a65 removes only the bare attribute while retaining `dual_spec` and the contract.
